findings.th: โอทอปพร้อมค้า
findings.text: Only 0.1% of records carry the three signals a buyer needs at the same time — a category, a contact, and an OPC grade. The other 99.9% are name-only registrations.

findings.th: ความเห็นตรงกัน
findings.text: 66.6% of records are attested by more than one agency. Without corroboration, a record is one office's filing; with it, two or more agreed.

findings.th: ได้รับการคัดสรร
findings.text: 13,939 records (8.8%) carry an OPC star grade. Mean grade of those: 4.01★. 5,317 are 5-star; 4,789 are 4-star.

findings.th: ความเข้มข้น
findings.text: The ten most-filed provinces hold 28.1% of all records. The remaining 67 provinces share the rest.

findings.th: ช่วงความน่าเชื่อถือ
findings.text: บุรีรัมย์ is the most cross-attested province (89.3% of its records corroborated by ≥2 agencies); เชียงราย is the least (31.8%). Same data source, very different administrative depth.

findings.th: ความสดใหม่
findings.text: 21,287 records (13.4%) carry a filing year. Median filing year is 2022. The other 86.6% cannot be dated from the registry.
